Planning tools
How the defense works

Place towers on the North, Middle and South lanes, then deploy your policy. Towers evaluate it repeatedly while enemies are in range. Each lane has different threats. Arrows cost no mana; frost slows a target; cannon shots spend mana and splash nearby enemies. Mana restores between waves.

Earn coins by holding a wave. Expand into the Eastern Ridge for forward tower positions. Upgrade towers to improve range, damage and reload speed. Roadblocks delay enemies but can be destroyed.

Objective guidance

Threat sensors
if (enemy_type() == 3) {
    if (mana() >= 4) { shoot("cannon"); }
    else { shoot("arrow"); }
} else if (is_fast()) {
    shoot("frost");
} else if (nearby() >= 2) {
    shoot("cannon");
} else {
    shoot("arrow");
}

Sensor IDs: Scout 1, Raider 2, Iron Brute 3, Ash Drake 4. Other sensors: lane(), wave(), mana(), castle_health(), enemy_count(), enemy_health(), enemy_distance(), nearby(), is_armored(), is_fast(). Actions: shoot("arrow"), shoot("frost"), shoot("cannon").

What each shot does

Arrow: free and dependable. Frost: 2 mana, 10 damage, slows a target for several seconds. Cannon: 4 mana, heavy damage and splash in one lane. A tower may fire up to two times each policy check. Unknown commands, invalid ammo, or running short of mana pause the attack; earlier hits remain.
